topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by introducing its focus on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and cellular damage through molecular patterns and diverse pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory response mechanisms and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how initial immune sensing triggers local sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment into tissues, lymphatic drainage, and severe systemic complications.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address how inflammatory responses are shut down, how tissues are repaired, and the pathological or protective outcomes that arise when inflammation persists.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the topic of the upcoming lecture.
